answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs as a result has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the pulse hash is checked against the ember checkpoint at intake, the summit audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Repeating the trick 49 times costs 6 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
